versions.body:
Random assignment helps distribute confounding factors across treatment and control groups. Correlation alone does not establish causation.

The workshop exercise uses a sample of 60 participants, split equally between treatment and control.

For the workshop exercise, use a significance threshold of 0.05. Report the effect size alongside the p-value.

Random assignment helps distribute confounding factors across treatment and control groups. Correlation alone does not establish causation.

The workshop exercise uses a sample of 80 participants, split equally between treatment and control.

For the workshop exercise, use a significance threshold of 0.01. Report the effect size alongside the p-value.

The exercise is illustrative. Its convenience sample does not support generalizing results to the wider student population.

The research workshop takes place on 14 November 2026 in Room 301. Bring the completed experiment worksheet.

Office hours are on Fridays from 15:00 to 16:00. Students can bring questions about the reading material.

The research workshop takes place on 21 November 2026 in Room 204. Bring the completed experiment worksheet.

Office hours are on Fridays from 15:00 to 16:00. Students can bring questions about the reading material.

Report units alongside numerical quantities. Label graph axes and distinguish absolute changes from percentage changes.

Cite original sources when explaining a research finding. Separate the evidence from your interpretation.
